name: Young Elms Theater Camp
description_short: One week Wicked themed theater camp for ages 7 to 11 at Elmwood Playhouse in Nyack, where campers sing, act short scenes, learn choreography, play improv games, write and make crafts. There is no live show; families get a video of the week.

sessions.name: Dancing Through Life: Wicked Theater Camp

fees.name: After camp care (3 to 4 pm)
fees.note: Per child, subject to staff availability

notes: 9 am to 3 pm; capacity 20 campers. 10% sibling discount; $50 early registration discount ended March 31, 2026. No partial weeks. Campers bring a nut free lunch and two snacks.
